core_obligations: Observe that the given morphism X' to X can be regarded as a family of morphisms forming a tau covering (proof lines 6885-6886).
Apply locality of P on the source to conclude that the composite of f with that morphism has P (proof lines 6884-6886).

Transfer the property by locality on the source.
difficulty_reason: For a topology tau among fpqc, fppf, syntomic, smooth, etale and Zariski, a property P of morphisms which is tau local on the source, a morphism f with P and a morphism a into the source which is flat, flat and locally of finite presentation, syntomic, etale or an open immersion, the lemma shows that the composite of f with a again has P (statement lines 6873-6881). As in the companion statement the proof names the mechanism: the morphism a can be fitted into a family forming a tau covering, and locality of P on the source then gives the composite the property (proof lines 6884-6886). The claim is H2: one covering-family observation, but it is exactly the input the locality axiom needs, and the five listed cases are handled uniformly by it.
